arguments.text:
All 7 requirements implemented and verified:

[R1] Immutability: __slots__ + read-only properties on VersionInfo prevent attribute modification (AttributeError raised).
[R2] Iteration: __iter__ yields major, minor, patch, prerelease, build in order.
[R3] Comparison: __eq__, __ne__, __lt__, __le__, __gt__, __ge__ all handle tuples correctly; strings raise TypeError, integers return False.
[R4] Bump methods: bump_major, bump_minor, bump_patch, bump_prerelease, bump_build each return a new VersionInfo instance with the respective component incremented.
[R5] Type conversion: Constructor converts major/minor/patch to int, prerelease/build to str.
[R6] CLI: Module exposes createparser(), main(), and process() functions for pysemver CLI.
[R7] Replace: Module-level replace() function and VersionInfo.replace() method both work correctly.

All 106 existing tests pass. STATUS.json written at repository root.
